messages: hey. first time using this, not sure what to say lol
Hey. No script needed. How was today?
i finished the lab report
A finished report counts. Nice work.
aj pura din class mein hi nikal gaya 😭
That is a long stretch. Did you get a proper break?
quiz went fine, going to sleep early
Early night sounds like a good reward.
my fyp group finally agreed on a topic
That is progress. What did you land on?
the others will wake up near the deadline 😅
You sound prepared for the group rhythm.
the login module finally worked
That is a satisfying win. Did it make the next step clearer?
maybe i will sleep earlier tonight
Even one earlier night helps.
i got 14 out of 30 in OS
That is below what you hoped for. How are you taking it?
i can recover, i will ask where i lost marks
That is a smart next step.
ahmed left the fyp group and now i do both parts
That is a big hit. Could your supervisor help shrink the scope?
the demo is in eight days
That is a lot, so asking early is worthwhile.
couldn't sleep, kept thinking about everything
Writing the list down can get it out of your head.
i froze and do not know where to start
Start with one short email asking for ten minutes.
i skipped lectures and stayed in my room
Sounds like today asked more than you had. Is someone nearby?
i do not feel like talking
No pressure. Could you do one small thing for yourself?
i feel numb and tired all the time
That is a lot to carry. Support can connect you with the university counselor.
nothing to say today. just tired
That is okay. I am here, and Support is available whenever you want it.
salam, thought i would check this out
Wa alaikum assalam. How has your week been?
bas assignments aur cricket
That is not a bad mix.
we won the quarter final 😎
Congratulations! What was the best moment?
my arm is dead today
A good problem after a win.
semi final lost, we choked
That hurts after a good run. How are you holding up?
started the DB assignment
Four tables is a decent start.
are you chatgpt or gemini?
I am MindPulse's AI companion. What made you curious?
just wanted to know who i am talking to
That makes sense.
DB assignment submitted before the deadline
That counts. How are you feeling about it?
i have to act as team lead next week
That can be a lot. Do you want to talk it through?
practiced the presentation in the mirror
Mirror practice works even when it feels silly.
need to cut two minutes
That is a clear next step.
cousin visit was fun, we had biryani
That sounds like a proper break.
presentation tomorrow, sleeping early
Good plan.
presentation was a disaster
Oh no. What happened?
the projector failed and i forgot my points
That was rough, not a measure of your ability.
my group was fine about it
That is a relief.
i can redo it next week
A fair second chance.
back to normal, played cricket
Good to hear. Does it clear your head?
i will practice tomorrow
That sounds like a plan.
my thesis has taken over my head
Thesis stress can crowd out everything. Which part is hardest?
forty papers and no structure
Sorting them into themes may make it smaller.
grouped the papers into four themes
That is real progress. How does it feel now?
tuition is fun, not pressure
That is worth protecting.
my landlady raised the rent
That is stressful, especially when stretched.
ghar pe baat karun? mama will worry
You do not have to decide tonight.
found a possible roommate
That was quick. How are you feeling?
nervous but hopeful
That combination makes sense.
the roommate seems nice
A trial month keeps the pressure low.
supervisor meeting tomorrow
Sending the draft early helps.
supervisor said the literature review is shallow
That is hard to hear after the work you put in.
deadline is in three weeks
That is tight, but not nothing.
stayed up till four reworking sections
That is a brutal mix. What would give you one hour of rest?
everything is piling up
You only need the next small thing today.
new roommate comes tomorrow and nothing is finished
Too much is landing together. What is actually urgent?
i cannot think straight
Shorter work stretches may help.
ghar se call aayi, maine kaha sab theek hai
Carrying that alone is exhausting. Is there a friend you can be honest with?
just tired, did not open the thesis
Rest if you can. Support is there whenever you want it.
